title: Why do cats purr?
examples: Does a cat purr when it is scared?
How does a cat make that rumbling sound?
Can I teach my cat to purr on command?

explain.say: Cats make a soft, low sound called purring.

items: It is a cat's unique noise

explain.say: Purring comes from the cat's throat and chest.
It is made by small muscles in the throat moving very fast.
Cats often purr when they feel happy and safe.
Cats also purr when they feel unwell or need comfort. Purring may help them feel calm.
If you gently stroke a cat you know, it may start to purr.

faq.q: Why do cats purr when they are scared?
faq.a: Cats can purr when they feel scared or stressed. It might be a way to calm themselves down when things feel overwhelming.
asks: Is purring a sign of fear?

faq.q: Is purring only a sign that a cat is happy?
faq.a: No, purring can mean several things. It can show contentment, but it can also mean the cat is healing or feeling secure.

faq.q: How loud can a cat purr?
faq.a: A purr is a low, soft sound. You can often feel it more than hear it.
asks: How do you hear the purr?

faq.a: Most pet cats purr. Some purr a lot, and some purr only a little.
asks: Is purring normal for all cats?

faq.q: Can I make my cat purr?
faq.a: You can try petting your cat gently in a way it likes. If it feels safe, it might start to purr for you.
asks: How do I make a cat purr?
What works to get a cat to purr?

facts: Purring is a vibration that comes from the cat's chest.
Cats use purring to communicate feelings of safety.
Some scientists think purring may help cats heal.

quiz.say: A cat makes a soft, low rumble on a blanket. What is it doing?
quiz.why: A soft, low rumble is a purr.

wrong.0: A hiss is a sharp sound a cat makes when it feels scared.
wrong.2: A meow is a call, often to ask for something.

quiz.say: A cat purrs while you stroke it gently. How does it feel?
quiz.why: Purring while being stroked shows the cat feels happy and safe.

wrong.1: A hungry cat often meows for food.
wrong.2: An angry cat may hiss or swish its tail.

quiz.say: A cat purrs when it feels unwell. What might the purring do?
quiz.why: Purring may help a cat feel calm when it feels unwell.

wrong.0: A hiss or a growl warns others, and a purr is a calm sound.
wrong.1: A meow is the usual call for food.
